workflow_pattern: This is a 'U1_search_count_report' style workflow. It requires the following operations, in roughly this order: search repositories by owner and keyword, count issues by label and state, create repo and upload report, generate json report. The task should combine these operations into one coherent, realistic request without listing them as separate steps.
question: Hey! As a security engineer evaluating secret-management tooling for our infra, I'm auditing HashiCorp's Vault-related projects before we standardize on one. Please search for all repositories owned by 'hashicorp' that contain 'vault' in their name. For each repository, count the open issues that are labeled 'bug'. Then create a new repository under your account called 'hashicorp-vault-issues' (if it doesn't already exist) and upload a JSON report named 'hashicorp_vault_bug_report.json' structured as {repository_name: open_bug_count, ...}. This will help our team decide whether the Vault ecosystem is healthy enough to roll out company-wide. Thanks a bunch!
